1. [Framework] The experiment MUST use OmniRec as the experimentation framework. Algorithms MUST be specified via omnirec.runner.algos.LensKit (PopScorer, ItemKNNScorer, ImplicitMFScorer) and executed via run_omnirec().

2. [Datasets] The experiment MUST run on exactly three datasets loaded via RecSysDataSet.use_dataloader(): DataSet.MovieLens100K (explicit), DataSet.Amazon2014VideoGames (explicit), and DataSet.HetrecLastFM (implicit).
3. [Preprocessing - Implicit Conversion] For MovieLens100K and Amazon2014VideoGames, ratings > 3 MUST be converted to implicit feedback via MakeImplicit(3) in the preprocessing pipeline.
4. [Preprocessing - Core Pruning] All three datasets MUST have 5-core filtering (CorePruning(5)) applied in the preprocessing pipeline.
5. [Data Splitting] The experiment MUST use UserHoldout(validation_size=0.0, test_size=0.2) for user-based 80/20 train/test split.

6. [Random Seeds] The experiment MUST be repeated for 5 distinct random seeds (e.g., 42, 123, 456, 789, 1111). For each seed, set_random_state(seed) MUST be called before creating that seed's preprocessing pipeline to control data splitting randomness.
7. [Algorithms] Three algorithms MUST be tested: LensKit.ImplicitMFScorer (ALS), LensKit.ItemKNNScorer, and LensKit.PopScorer, all configured with feedback='implicit' and default hyperparameters.
8. [Evaluation Metrics] The evaluation MUST compute nDCG@k and Precision@k for k=[1, 5, 10] using NDCG and Precision from omnirec.metrics.ranking, passed to Evaluator from omnirec.runner.evaluation.
9. [Full Factorial Design] The experiment MUST execute a full factorial design: all 3 algorithms x all 3 datasets x all 5 seeds = 45 runs.

10. [Results & Statistical Analysis] Results MUST be reported in tabular form per (dataset, algorithm, seed) showing all metrics. The implementation MUST compute and report mean and standard deviation across the 5 seeds for each algorithm-dataset combination to quantify the impact of random seed variation on accuracy.
